_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: black and white comic strip panel, scratchy crow-quill pen and ballpoint ink on cardstock, harsh photocopy contrast, heavy black spotting, jagged uneven line weights, 1990s indie comix zine style, xerox grain, no color, no gray tones. model sheet of a thin young man in his early twenties in a worn brown canvas chore coat with a frayed cuff and a mismatched button, stubble, dark uncombed hair, hands in pockets; front, profile, seated-on-a-bucket pose, plus expression heads: dead-eyed, earnest, blank, wounded; labeled WOOD 2000. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: color, gray gradients, photorealistic, 3D render, smooth digital line, watermark, extra fingers
